items.text: Ashley M. Brown is a psychiatric social worker for the Los Angeles Unified School District. She is a union member.

sentences.text: Ashley M. Brown is a psychiatric social worker for the Los Angeles Unified School District.

items.text: Her campaign lists her top three priorities as mental health care and women’s health, education and economic stability, and community safety through prevention and youth investment. Her campaign says she believes community safety starts with strong schools, accessible mental health care, and sustained investment in youth.
